// Generated by configure_facebook.py. No Meta app secret belongs in the app.
import 'package:flutter_facebook_auth/flutter_facebook_auth.dart';
import 'facebook_identity.dart';
const facebookConfigured=true;
Future<FacebookIdentity?> requestFacebookIdentity(String hashedNonce) async {
  final result=await FacebookAuth.instance.login(permissions:const ['email','public_profile'],
    loginTracking:LoginTracking.limited,nonce:hashedNonce);
  if(result.status==LoginStatus.cancelled)return null;
  if(result.status!=LoginStatus.success||result.accessToken==null)throw StateError('Facebook sign-in failed');
  final token=result.accessToken!;
  return FacebookIdentity(token.tokenString,limited:token.type==AccessTokenType.limited);
}
Future<void> clearFacebookSession() async {await FacebookAuth.instance.logOut();}
